## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

## Empowering Leaders. Driving Results. Together.

 

 

Success in business doesn’t come with a manual — especially in today’s fast-evolving world. But
you’re not alone. Countless executives have faced the same challenges you’re navigating, from
crafting winning strategies to investing in cutting-edge technologies and attracting the customers
who matter most. The difference? They partnered with Forrester.

Through a **unique continuous guidance model** that blends research, consulting, and live events, we
ensure you stay ahead of every curve. Equipped with the latest trends, innovations, and data, our
tailored interactions empower you to act swiftly and decisively.

With insights drawn from surveying over **500,000 consumers, executives, and tech leaders
annually**, Forrester consultants and analysts are unrivaled in understanding the challenges you
face. Whatever hurdles you encounter, we’ve seen them — and solved them.


 

Learn more about how Forrester can help you stay ahead of the curve.

> SVP, Commercial Operations & Marketing, Dun & Bradstreet

## Put Forrester AI Into Action Where You Work

Forrester is reinventing research for the AI era by combining human insight with responsible,
research‑grounded AI. With Forrester AI available in Microsoft Teams, leaders now stay in the flow
of their work and add trusted advice, data, and frameworks directly inside the tools they use every
day.

Built on Forrester’s proprietary research and governed by transparency and trust, Forrester AI helps
teams move faster, stay aligned, and make confident decisions when it matters most. Forrester AI
delivers expertise into the moments where decisions get made — for every level of the organization.

# Your next dream job is here

Hirify is a job board and meta-aggregator of the best IT and Digital jobs.  Why Hirify is different
* We collect directly from career pages - we take vacancies straight from company sites, including
  custom career sites other aggregators do not reach.
* Updated every 2 hours - we cycle through our sources continuously, so new vacancies often appear
  here before they do on other platforms, including the big ones.
* Deduplication across 960+ Telegram channels - catches around 90% of duplicates, so the same job
  posted across dozens of channels usually does not repeat in your feed. We match title and company,
  contacts, vector similarity, and AI checks the borderline pairs.
* Smart filter - 15+ parameters (specialization, stack, domain, English, format, company type, geo),
  each with an exclude mode. You can also build the filter just by typing - AI parses a
  plain-language request.
* Telegram alerts - save as many filters as you want and get notified across all of them.
  Deduplication works here too: if a vacancy matches several of your filters, it arrives once, not
  as duplicates.

## The heavy cost of generic CRM software

### The generic tax

Most teams pay Salesforce or HubSpot large per seat fees for features they never use. You bend your
entire business process to fit their generic software database.

### The growing bill

Maintaining these systems requires constant admin overhead and workarounds. When your team grows,
your annual bill climbs even if your workflow stays the same.

The shift

Building custom software used to be too expensive for a single team. Now, an experienced team and a
tightly scoped build make custom CRM development highly cost effective.

## How it works

01

### Scope your use case

We study how your team uses your current CRM. We map your fields, pipelines, automations, and
required integrations to design your custom system.

02

### Build your custom CRM

Our engineering team builds your database and interface. You get a CRM designed for your process
with zero unused modules.

03

### Migrate your data

We import your records, histories, and pipelines from your old system. We ensure the switch happens
without losing any of your existing work.

04

### Run and support the system

We host and maintain your CRM on our managed servers or your own infrastructure. Our team stays on
to handle ongoing changes and support.

## Why teams switch

### Lower annual costs

Teams typically cut their CRM spend by 5x to 10x. You pay an ongoing yearly fee for development and
hosting with zero per seat licenses.

### Perfect process fit

Your software matches your actual workflow. We only build the pipelines, reports, and integrations
that your team actually uses every day.

### Run it on your infrastructure

You can host the system on your own infrastructure to meet strict compliance and data policies.

### Seamless data migration

We handle the entire migration process. Your historical records from Salesforce, HubSpot, or other
systems move over completely.

### Experienced human support

You work directly with an experienced development team. You do not have to wait in a generic
customer support queue or hire a reseller.

### Flexible integrations

We connect your new CRM with the business tools you already use. We choose and configure these
integrations during the scoping phase.

### #1Wispro

][43]

Wispro is a voice-to-writing tool designed to convert spoken language into clean, usable text
directly within your workflow. It caters to individuals who want to streamline their writing process
by leveraging their voice instead of typing. The primary purpose of Wispro is to offer a flexible
and intelligent way to generate written content, adapting to the user's natural speaking patterns.
The problem Wispro addresses is the time and effort typically involved in typing out thoughts,
ideas, or instructions. Many existing speech-to-text applications offer basic transcription but lack
the adaptability to truly integrate with a user's unique thinking and communication style. This can
lead to inefficient workflows and a disconnect between spoken ideas and written output. Wispro
offers three distinct modes to cater to various needs. Basic Mode provides a straightforward
transcription, capturing every word exactly as spoken, which is useful for verbatim records or when
precise speech capture is paramount. Smart Mode goes a step further by intelligently cutting out
filler words, hesitations, and rambling, then formatting the speech into coherent, polished prose.
This mode is ideal for drafting emails, reports, or any content where a clean and professional tone
is desired. Command Mode is a unique feature that allows users to turn spoken instructions into
finished written content. By simply stating a command, such as "write me an email about X" or "draft
a tweet about Y," Wispro generates the requested text on the spot. This mode is explicitly triggered
by a hotkey, distinguishing it from the other modes and ensuring that the application understands
when it's receiving an instruction rather than content to be transcribed. Another key aspect of
Wispro is its emphasis on personalization and flexibility. Unlike other tools with fixed presets for
different tones or contexts, Wispro allows users to define their own writing styles and rules in
their own words. This means the Smart Mode's cleanup and formatting are not generic but are tailored
to the user's specific instructions, effectively reshaping rambling thoughts into a personally
defined style. Wispro operates by utilizing advanced AI models, specifically mentioning the
integration with Whisper large-v3 for its multilingual capabilities and Groq API for processing. The

on-device, ensuring user privacy and offline functionality. It allows users to hold the Fn key,

application. The core of Megaphone's functionality lies in its integration with Apple's advanced
on-device technologies, specifically SpeechAnalyzer for real-time transcription and Foundation
Models for intelligent text processing. The problem Megaphone addresses is the common reliance on
cloud-based dictation services, which often come with privacy concerns, subscription fees, and the
need for an internet connection. Many existing solutions involve sending audio data to external
servers for transcription and processing, creating potential bottlenecks and security risks.

software to provide a seamless, private, and efficient dictation experience. One of the key features

directly within your workflow. It caters to individuals who want to streamline their writing process

and intelligent way to generate written content, adapting to the user's natural speaking patterns.
The problem Wispro addresses is the time and effort typically involved in typing out thoughts,
ideas, or instructions. Many existing speech-to-text applications offer basic transcription but lack
the adaptability to truly integrate with a user's unique thinking and communication style. This can
lead to inefficient workflows and a disconnect between spoken ideas and written output. Wispro
offers three distinct modes to cater to various needs. Basic Mode provides a straightforward
transcription, capturing every word exactly as spoken, which is useful for verbatim records or when
precise speech capture is paramount. Smart Mode goes a step further by intelligently cutting out
filler words, hesitations, and rambling, then formatting the speech into coherent, polished prose.
This mode is ideal for drafting emails, reports, or any content where a clean and professional tone
is desired. Command Mode is a unique feature that allows users to turn spoken instructions into
finished written content. By simply stating a command, such as "write me an email about X" or "draft
a tweet about Y," Wispro generates the requested text on the spot. This mode is explicitly triggered
by a hotkey, distinguishing it from the other modes and ensuring that the application understands
when it's receiving an instruction rather than content to be transcribed. Another key aspect of
Wispro is its emphasis on personalization and flexibility. Unlike other tools with fixed presets for
different tones or contexts, Wispro allows users to define their own writing styles and rules in
their own words. This means the Smart Mode's cleanup and formatting are not generic but are tailored
to the user's specific instructions, effectively reshaping rambling thoughts into a personally
defined style. Wispro operates by utilizing advanced AI models, specifically mentioning the

# Online Whiteboard with Realtime Collaboration

## Virtual online whiteboard with team collaboration

Ziteboard is a lightweight whiteboard website which works on any device: laptops, tablets, mobile
devices – optimized for both iPad's Safari and Google Chrome on laptops.

[START DRAWING NOW][8]

Our service is designed for successful realtime tutoring. We understand the importance of a clean
and easy to use interface to best serve both teachers and students of all ages. By design, this
lightweight yet powerful visual platform aims to provide a simple tool for distance education. Using
such a platform you have infinite space to work on with your student or class in realtime.

## Live Teamwork on Online Whiteboard

[Shared whiteboard to work together.]

Collaborate in real time, wherever you are around the world, bring your team together on the same
whiteboard whatever device you use.

Design any workflow, wireframe or prototype, Ziteboard offers an infinite workplace for seeing the
big picture.

Boost any meeting, brainstorm, presentation, tutoring or training session.

Ziteboard is a visual collaboration platform improving the work for most remote teams, developers,
designers and making meetings, project planning and customer communication better.

## Insert images and PDF files

Drag-and-drop an image from another browser tab or use the file uploader from the Menu. For PDF
documents provide the page number or the range of the pages to be imported.

## Integrated board chat with audio and video capabilities

Distance learning becomes more convenient and personal as teachers and students engage face-to-face.
Enhance your learning experience with the integrated video chat feature on our whiteboard tool.

[Integrated video chat | Ziteboard.]

Initiate in-app voice and video chats effortlessly from the bottom left corner, enabling instant
visual communication for educators and private tutors. Students can join video calls with Free
accounts.

Ziteboard utilizes a lightning-fast peer-to-peer connection, ensuring participants stay connected
even with older devices.

[How does the voice and video chat work?][9]

## Cross Platform Compatibility

Access Ziteboard from any device with an internet connection, whether it's a desktop computer,
laptop, tablet or smartphone.

[Cross-platform compatible whiteboard.]

Our browser-based platform ensures seamless collaboration across different operating systems and
devices, including older models, thus ensuring that all users, especially students, can stay
connected and collaborate effectively regardless of the technology they have access to.

## Simplify Your Math Teaching with Math Tools

Empower your lessons with our Math Tools, designed for distant educators and tutors. The suite
includes the [Formula Editor][10] for effortlessly creating, editing, and displaying mathematical
formulas using LaTeX input or a user-friendly virtual keyboard, the [Graph Plotter][11] for
visualizing functions interactively, and the [Interactive Compass][12] for drawing precise circles
and arcs in geometry constructions.

[LaTeX Formula]

These tools are ideal for **private math tutors**, science educators, engineers, and anyone needing
to present complex equations, visualize graphs, or demonstrate geometry constructions with accuracy
and clarity. By using the Math Tools suite, you streamline your workflow, save time, and deliver
professional-quality content with ease.

## Export your whiteboard as a PDF or vector graphics

Export a **PNG** file if you quickly need a good quality image of the visible screen.

Export the whole board as a zoomable, **vector based SVG** file to feed Adobe Illustrator or any
image editor.

It's worth switching on the "Display A4 pages" option in the Settings before a lesson if you want to
export an already formatted **PDF document** at the end. Explore the options: [Export
whiteboard][13].

## Shared Whiteboard

Ziteboard serves as a versatile **shared whiteboard**, offering a touch-friendly online platform
accessible through any browser, as well as dedicated apps for iPad and Android. Its zoomable,

# Online Whiteboard with Realtime Collaboration

## Virtual online whiteboard with team collaboration

Ziteboard is a lightweight whiteboard website which works on any device: laptops, tablets, mobile
devices – optimized for both iPad's Safari and Google Chrome on laptops.

[START DRAWING NOW][8]

Our service is designed for successful realtime tutoring. We understand the importance of a clean
and easy to use interface to best serve both teachers and students of all ages. By design, this
lightweight yet powerful visual platform aims to provide a simple tool for distance education. Using
such a platform you have infinite space to work on with your student or class in realtime.

## Live Teamwork on Online Whiteboard

[Shared whiteboard to work together.]

Collaborate in real time, wherever you are around the world, bring your team together on the same
whiteboard whatever device you use.

Design any workflow, wireframe or prototype, Ziteboard offers an infinite workplace for seeing the
big picture.

Boost any meeting, brainstorm, presentation, tutoring or training session.

Ziteboard is a visual collaboration platform improving the work for most remote teams, developers,
designers and making meetings, project planning and customer communication better.

## Insert images and PDF files

Drag-and-drop an image from another browser tab or use the file uploader from the Menu. For PDF
documents provide the page number or the range of the pages to be imported.

## Integrated board chat with audio and video capabilities

Distance learning becomes more convenient and personal as teachers and students engage face-to-face.
Enhance your learning experience with the integrated video chat feature on our whiteboard tool.

[Integrated video chat | Ziteboard.]

Initiate in-app voice and video chats effortlessly from the bottom left corner, enabling instant
visual communication for educators and private tutors. Students can join video calls with Free
accounts.

Ziteboard utilizes a lightning-fast peer-to-peer connection, ensuring participants stay connected
even with older devices.

[How does the voice and video chat work?][9]

## Cross Platform Compatibility

Access Ziteboard from any device with an internet connection, whether it's a desktop computer,
laptop, tablet or smartphone.

[Cross-platform compatible whiteboard.]

Our browser-based platform ensures seamless collaboration across different operating systems and
devices, including older models, thus ensuring that all users, especially students, can stay
connected and collaborate effectively regardless of the technology they have access to.

## Simplify Your Math Teaching with Math Tools

Empower your lessons with our Math Tools, designed for distant educators and tutors. The suite
includes the [Formula Editor][10] for effortlessly creating, editing, and displaying mathematical
formulas using LaTeX input or a user-friendly virtual keyboard, the [Graph Plotter][11] for
visualizing functions interactively, and the [Interactive Compass][12] for drawing precise circles
and arcs in geometry constructions.

[LaTeX Formula]

These tools are ideal for **private math tutors**, science educators, engineers, and anyone needing
to present complex equations, visualize graphs, or demonstrate geometry constructions with accuracy
and clarity. By using the Math Tools suite, you streamline your workflow, save time, and deliver
professional-quality content with ease.

## Export your whiteboard as a PDF or vector graphics

Export a **PNG** file if you quickly need a good quality image of the visible screen.

Export the whole board as a zoomable, **vector based SVG** file to feed Adobe Illustrator or any
image editor.

It's worth switching on the "Display A4 pages" option in the Settings before a lesson if you want to
export an already formatted **PDF document** at the end. Explore the options: [Export
whiteboard][13].

One platform

## One platform for every cab booking need

Whether you're booking a ride, managing corporate transportation, or expanding your transport
business, Zoyride brings riders, businesses, and transport suppliers together on one trusted
platform.
* ### For Riders
  
  Book outstation cabs, airport taxi, local city rides, and hourly car rental from verified
  transport providers with transparent pricing and zero surcharge.
  
  [Book a ride][25]
* ### For Businesses
  
  Manage employee transportation, corporate cab booking, airport transfers, and recurring mobility
  needs through one platform. GST-compliant billing. One invoice.
  
  [Explore for business][26]
* ### For Suppliers
  
  Grow your transport business by reaching riders and corporates actively searching for reliable cab
  services. Set your own fares. Fee drops as your rating rises.
  
  [Become a supplier][27]

How the marketplace works

## Zoyride sits in the middle — so everyone wins

We are the trusted mediator between demand and supply. Every booking is matched, verified, and
protected.
1. Demand
   
   ### Rider or Business
   
   Submits a booking or transport request — local ride, corporate fleet, hourly rental, or
   outstation trip.
2. Trusted mediator
   
   ### Zoyride
   
   Matches with the right verified supplier. Handles booking, payment, tracking, and quality
   assurance.
3. Verified supply
   
   ### Verified Supplier
   
   Receives the booking, delivers the service, collects payment — and earns lower fees the higher
   their rating grows.

Why riders choose Zoyride

## Why riders choose Zoyride for cab booking online

Transparent fares, trusted suppliers, flexible payments, and smooth booking from start to finish.
* ### Zero Surcharge
  
  Suppliers set their own fares. Zoyride adds no surcharge. You always see the honest market rate —
  not a platform-inflated price.
* ### Verified Suppliers
  
  Every supplier is vetted, rated, and reviewed. Our rating system rewards quality — the better your
  service, the lower your fee.
* ### Quality Drives Reward
  
  Suppliers earn fee reductions through performance. 4★ rating = 5% fee. 5★ = just 2.5%. Great
  service costs less to list.
* ### Available 24/7
  
  Book anytime — early morning airport runs, late-night drop-offs, weekend getaways, or long
  corporate trips.
* ### All Payment Methods
  
  UPI, cards, wallets, and cash — fully reconciled and protected. Businesses get consolidated
  monthly billing.
* ### Easy Cancellations
  
  Plans changed? Cancel or modify your cab booking in seconds. Terms shown clearly before you
  confirm.

On the go, anywhere

Search, compare, book, track, and pay — all in the Zoyride app. Available on Android and iOS.
